1479-2841-6155-8338.easyPrerequisites:
Your life total is 2 or higher.
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Arid Mesa.
1479-2841-6155-8338.description:
Fetch a land using Arid Mesa.
When the fetched land enters, Shuttlecraft Galileo and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Shuttlecraft Galileo trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Shuttlecraft Galileo trigger from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Shuttlecraft Galileo triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

1557-2872-4613.easyPrerequisites:
Siren of the Silent Song doesn't have summoning sickness and has a +1/+1 counter on it.
Clever Conjurer is exiled by Agatha's Soul Cauldron.
1557-2872-4613.notablePrerequisites: You control another creature that doesn't have summoning sickness and has a +1/+1 counter on it.
1557-2872-4613.description:
Activate Siren of the Silent Song using Clever Conjurer's ability by tapping it, untapping another creature you control that has a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate the other creature using Clever Conjurer's ability by tapping it, untapping Siren of the Silent Song
Siren of the Silent Song triggers, causing each opponent to discard and mill a card.
Repeat.

1432-4613-6859.easyPrerequisites:
Servant of Tymaret doesn't have summoning sickness and has a +1/+1 counter on it.
Ioreth of the Healing House is exiled by Agatha's Soul Cauldron.
1432-4613-6859.notablePrerequisites: You control another creature that doesn't have summoning sickness and has a +1/+1 counter on it.
1432-4613-6859.description:
Activate Servant of Tymaret using Ioreth of the Healing House's ability by tapping it, untapping another creature you control that has a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate the other creature using Ioreth of the Healing House's ability by tapping it, untapping Servant of Tymaret
Servant of Tymaret triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain that much life.
Repeat.

4770-4885-6090-6723.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying its mana cost.
When Whitemane Lion enters, it and Arahbo trigger.
Resolve the Arahbo trigger, creating a 1/1 Cat creature token.
Holding priority, activate Whitemane Lion and the Cat token by tapping them, adding {1}{W}.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

339-677-4247-4460.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

380-728-3362.description:
Cast Bladewing by paying {3}{B}{B}{R}{R}.
When Bladewing enters the battlefield, it and Miirym trigger.
Resolve the Bladewing trigger, returning any Dragon from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Bladewing.
Resolve the Miirym trigger, creating a nonlegendary token copy of Bladewing.
When the Bladewing token enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Bladewing from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
Resolve all Grimgrin abilities.

2267-7084-8095.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Tormod triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Repeat.

586-864-3125-4247-7422.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
586-864-3125-4247-7422.description:
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire twice by sacrificing Priest of Gix and Eternal Witness.
Cast Victimize by paying {2}{B} and sacrificing another creature, returning Eternal Witness and Priest of Gix from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Priest of Gix and Eternal Witness enter, they each trigger as well as Garrison Excavator.
Resolve the Priest of Gix trigger, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Resolve the Garrison Excavator trigger, creating a creature token
Resolve the Eternal Witness trigger, returning Victimize from your graveyard to your hand.
Garrison Excavator triggers, creating a creature token
Repeat.

uses.n: Budoka Gardener // Dokai, Weaver of Life

1993-3257-7857.easyPrerequisites: You control eight or fewer lands.
1993-3257-7857.description:
Activate Budoka Gardener // Dokai, Weaver of Life by tapping it, putting Rakdos Carnarium from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Rakdos Carnarium enters the battlefield, it and Elven Raft-Steerer trigger.
Resolve the Rakdos Carnarium trigger, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Elven Raft-Steerer trigger, untapping Budoka Gardener // Dokai, Weaver of Life.
Repeat.

2348-5702-7824.easyPrerequisites: You control a Forest that enters the battlefield untapped.
2348-5702-7824.description:
Cast Springheart Nantuko for its bestow cost by paying {1}{G}, attaching it to the Forest that enters untapped.
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of the Forest
When the Forest tokens enter, Springheart Nantuko triggers twice.
Holding priority, activate the Forest tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Resolve the first Springheart Nantuko trigger, choosing not to pay and creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Resolve the second Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of the Forest that enters untapped.
Repeat from step 3.

2232-7827-7834-7835.easyPrerequisites: One of the Dwarves with mana value 1 must be on your hand, with the other on the battlefield.
2232-7827-7834-7835.description:
Cast the Dwarf with mana value 1 that's in your hand by paying its mana cost.
When the Dwarf enters, Cloudstone Curio and Thorin trigger.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning the other Dwarf with mana value 1 from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Thorin trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {R}.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control

3259-7297-7795.notablePrerequisites: At least one opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-7297-7795.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached and Drider, triggering Breath of Fury and Drider.
Resolve the Drider trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

855-1806-2060-2921-7367.description:
Activate Eternal Scourge's scavenge ability, granted to it by Young Deathclaws, by paying {3} and exiling Eternal Scourge from your graveyard, putting six +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler due to Corpsejack Menace.
Activate Crystalline Crawler six times by removing six +1/+1 counters from it, adding {6}.
Cast Eternal Scourge from exile by paying {3}.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Eternal Scourge.
Repeat.

2438-4871-5220-5447.notablePrerequisites:
You control a nontoken creature that can be cast using one colored mana.
You have solved Case of the Locked Hothouse.
2438-4871-5220-5447.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing the nontoken creature.
When the creature dies, Mortuary and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Cast the creature from the top of your library by paying its mana cost
Repeat.

11-2631-5864-7089.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill Fire Lord Azula
11-2631-5864-7089.description:
Declare Fire Lord Azula as an attacker, triggering its firebending ability, adding {R}{R}.
Holding priority, cast Alrund's Epiphany by paying its mana cost.
Fire Lord Azula's second ability triggers, copying Alrund's Epiphany.
Holding priority, cast Narset's Reversal by paying {U}{U}, targeting the original Alrund's Epiphany spell.
Fire Lord Azula's second ability triggers, copying Narset's Reversal, targeting the original Narset's Reversal.
Resolve the copy of Narset's Reversal, causing you to copy Narset's Reversal targeting the original Alrund's Epiphany spell, and then return the original Narset's Reversal to your hand.
Resolve the copy of Narset's Reversal, copying Alrund's Epiphany and returning the original Alrund's Epiphany to your hand.
Resolve both copies of Alrund's Epiphany from steps 3 and 7, causing you to take two extra turns after this one.
Repeat during your second extra turn.

141-5117-5231.description:
Cast Undying Malice by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, copying Undying Malice, with the copy targeting Naru Meha.
Resolve the copy of Undying Malice.
Holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing Naru Meha.
When Naru Meha dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

2034-4681-6981.description:
Cast Perigee Beckoner for its warp cost by paying {1}{B}.
When Perigee Beckoner enters, it triggers, targeting Karmic Guide.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Perigee Beckoner.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Karmic Guide.
When Karmic Guide dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Karmic Guide enters, it triggers, returning Perigee Beckoner from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Perigee Beckoner enters, it triggers, targeting Karmic Guide.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

5007-6798-6972.description:
If Morselhoarder has any -1/-1 counters on it, activate it by removing a -1/-1 counter from it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat step 1 as necessary until Morselhoarder has no -1/-1 counters on it.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Morselhoarder.
When Morselhoarder dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat.

1939-2173-2292-5220.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2 if Lunarch Veteran is on the battlefield.
1939-2173-2292-5220.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing it.
When Viscera Seer dies, Mortuary and Luminous Phantom triggers if it's on the battlefield
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Viscera Seer from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Luminous Phantom trigger, if applicable, causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Cast Viscera Seer from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
When Viscera Seer enters, Lunarch Veteran triggers if it's on the battlefield, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat.

2457-3000-5794-6441.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two 1/1 Insect and two 1/1 Squirrel creature tokens.
Activate Baylen's first ability twice by tapping the Squirrel and Insect tokens, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat.

413-4215-5220.notablePrerequisites: You control a green nontoken creature.
413-4215-5220.description:
Activate Blasting Station by sacrificing a green nontoken creature.
When the creature dies, Verdant Succession and Mortuary trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting the creature on top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Verdant Succession trigger, returning the creature from your library to the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1.
Repeat.

1283-2034-6115.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Ozox, adding {C}{C}.
When Ozox dies, it triggers, creating a legendary 2/1 Jumblebones creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Jumblebones, adding {C}{C}.
When Jumblebones dies, it triggers, returning Ozox from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Ozox by paying {2}{B}.
Repeat.

413-2757-3327.notablePrerequisites:
You have sacrificed at least three artifacts and/or creatures this turn, plus an additional artifact or creature for each time you've cast Dargo from the command zone this game.
You control a basic Mountain.
413-2757-3327.description:
Activate a basic Mountain, adding {R}.
Cast Dargo from the command zone by paying {R}.
When Dargo enters the battlefield, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping Dargo, untapping a basic Mountain.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Dargo.
Choose to return Dargo from your graveyard to the command zone.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.

1820-2837-3259.notablePrerequisites:
Breath of Fury attached to another creature you control that can attack this turn.
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
Galadriel does not have summoning sickness.
1820-2837-3259.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Galadriel as attackers.
Galadriel triggers, creating a 2/2 Cat creature token with haste due to Jinnie Fay.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached.
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the Cat token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

1379-1543-2032-4312.notablePrerequisites:
Vorel of the Hull Clade does not have summoning sickness.
Kiora has at least 12 loyalty counters on it.
1379-1543-2032-4312.description:
Activate Vorel of the Hull Clade by paying {G}{U} and tapping it, doubling the number of counters on Kiora.
Activate Kiora by removing twelve loyalty counters from it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

1210-3098-3449-3809-5195.description:
Cast Déjà Vu by paying {1}{U}, targeting Call to Mind.
Storm-Kiln Artist and Jace's Sanctum trigger.
Resolve the Jace's Sanctum trigger, causing you to scry 1.
Resolve the Storm-Kiln Artist trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve Déjà Vu, returning Call to Mind from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate the Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}{U}.
Cast Call to Mind by paying {1}{U}, targeting Déjà Vu.
Storm-Kiln Artist and Jace's Sanctum trigger.
Resolve the Jace's Sanctum trigger, causing you to scry 1.
Resolve the Storm-Kiln Artist trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}{U}.
Repeat.

2152-2770-4691.description:
Cast Donate by paying {2}{U}, giving an opponent control of Vilis.
During that player's next draw step, they draw a card.
Fate Unraveler triggers, dealing 1 damage to that opponent.
Vilis triggers, causing the opponent to draw a card.
Repeat from step 3.

927-2962.description:
At the beginning of your end step, Jon Irenicus triggers, causing an opponent who controls no Islands to gain control of Pirate Ship.
Pirate Ship triggers, causing the opponent to sacrifice it.
However, Pirate Ship cannot be sacrificed due to its ability granted by Jon Irenicus.
Pirate Ship triggers again, creating a mandatory infinite loop that causes the game to end in a draw.

2085-4222.notablePrerequisites:
Freed from the Real attached to Kelpie Guide.
Kelpie Guide does not have summoning sickness.
You control a permanent that can tap to produce at least {1}{U}.
2085-4222.description:
Activate any mana-producing permanent you control by tapping it, adding at least {1}{U}.
Activate Kelpie Guide's first ability by tapping it, untapping the mana-producing permanent.
Activate Freed from the Real's second ability by paying {U}, untapping Kelpie Guide.
Repeat.

2839-4930.notablePrerequisites:
Goblin Charbelcher does not have summoning sickness.
All lands in library are Plains.
2839-4930.description:
Cast Endless Horizons by paying {3}{W}, exiling all Plains from your library.
Activate Goblin Charbelcher by paying {3} and tapping it, revealing your entire library, dealing damage equal to your library size to any target, and reordering your library.

751-2060-2854-3921.notablePrerequisites: Showdown of the Skalds has 2 or 3 lore counters on it.
751-2060-2854-3921.description:
Cast Shrieking Drake, putting 2 +1/+1 counter on Crystalline Crawler with Showdown of the Skalds.
Remove a +1/+1 counter from Crystalline Crawler to add {U}.
Shrieking Drake triggers, returning itself to your hand.
Repeat.

1987-2493-2510-3448.notablePrerequisites: Any instant exiled by Semblance Anvil.
1987-2493-2510-3448.description:
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, targeting Stadium Vendors and Archaeomancer, blinking them.
When Archaeomancer enters the battlefield, return Ghostly Flicker to you hand.
When Stadium Vendors enters the battlefield, add {U}{U}.
Repeat.

618-3580-4050.description:
Cast Lightning Crafter by paying {3}{R}.
When Lightning Crafter enters the battlefield, its champion ability triggers.
Holding priority, activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Lightning Crafter with haste.
When the token Lightning Crafter enters the battlefield, its champion ability triggers, exiling Kiki-Jiki.
Activate the token Lightning Crafter by tapping it, dealing 3 damage to any target.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the token Lightning Crafter.
When the token Lightning Crafter leaves the battlefield, it triggers, returning Kiki-Jiki from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
